description.value: Noodlebox is a BC-founded franchise chain serving customizable Asian-inspired noodle and rice boxes made fresh to order at a counter-service format. The Surrey location on Croydon Drive offers a broad menu spanning Pad Thai, Teriyaki, Kung Pao, Butter Chicken, and more, with vegan and gluten-friendly modifications available on request. It is a practical hot-meal stop for touring cyclists passing through South Surrey.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack at 5m; rack at 9m; rack at 49m; rack at 58m; rack at 59m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is a live corporate/franchise site for Noodlebox Canada, confirming the business is operational and the URL matches OSM. The menu page explicitly states dishes 'Can be made VEGAN' and 'Can be made GLUTEN-FRIENDLY,' and the site's online ordering flow confirms takeout as the primary service model. No website evidence exists for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities; the OSM location-specific phone (778-545-5421) cannot be verified because the fetched BC locations subpage was not included and the /contact page only lists a corporate number (888-363-7538).

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Noodlebox is a legitimate, active restaurant with vegan and gluten-friendly options and a takeout-first format well-suited to touring cyclists needing a quick, customizable hot meal. Cycling-specific amenities are unverified but the core food-stop value is clear.
